name: immofacile-fullstack
description: ImmoFacile - Immobilier Facile - Fullstack rent receipt management system

scripts.install:all: npm install && cd client && npm install && cd ../server && npm install
scripts.build:prod: npm run build && npm run start:prod
scripts.lint: cd client && npm run lint && cd ../server && npm run lint
scripts.lint:fix: cd client && npm run lint -- --fix && cd ../server && npm run lint -- --fix
scripts.security:audit: cd client && npm audit && cd ../server && npm audit
scripts.ci:check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build
scripts.test: cd client && npm test -- --run && cd ../server && npm test -- --coverage
